title: Joe Carlasare on “Extreme Fear” in Bitcoin: “I’m A Buyer Here”
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Joe Carlasare on “Extreme Fear” in Bitcoin: “I’m A Buyer Here” Bitcoin went from 57,000 to 82,000 in less than 90 days earlier this year, and Joe Carlasare says that's why he rejects the idea that capital can't flood back in. This post Joe Carlasare on “Extreme Fear” in Bitcoin: “I’m A Buyer Here” first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
